Ruby core/Enumerable idiom with a native JS form (e.g. `each` -> for-of, `fetch`/`key?` -> index + `in`, `match?` -> RegExp#test, `clear` -> `length = 0`, `present?`/`blank?` -> truthiness). The port performs the same operation under a JS-native spelling, so no same-named call appears. Verified equivalent (bucket b).
